hook.en: An email to a friend, a story for a magazine and a review of a film each have a different reader — so each needs a different tone, layout and opening.
hook.bm: E-mel kepada kawan, cerita untuk majalah dan ulasan filem masing-masing mempunyai pembaca yang berbeza — jadi setiap satu memerlukan nada, susun atur dan permulaan yang berbeza.

bigIdeas.en: Always think about purpose, audience and format before writing.
bigIdeas.bm: Sentiasa fikirkan tujuan, pembaca dan format sebelum menulis.

bigIdeas.en: Informal emails are friendly: greeting, chatty paragraphs, contractions, friendly closing.
bigIdeas.bm: E-mel tidak formal bersifat mesra: sapaan, perenggan santai, kontraksi, penutup mesra.

bigIdeas.en: Stories need a hook, a problem, a climax and a resolution; articles need a catchy title and an engaging opening.
bigIdeas.bm: Cerita memerlukan permulaan menarik, masalah, klimaks dan penyelesaian; rencana memerlukan tajuk menarik dan pembukaan yang memikat.

cells.en: Resolution and a lesson or twist
Catchy title + question to the reader

definition.en: The person or group you are writing for.
definition.bm: Orang atau kumpulan yang anda tulis untuknya.

definition.en: The attitude of the writing: friendly, formal, persuasive.
definition.bm: Sikap dalam penulisan: mesra, formal, memujuk.

definition.en: An opening that grabs the reader's attention.
The most exciting or tense point of a story.
Ending that tells readers what to do.
definition.bm: Penutup yang memberitahu pembaca apa yang perlu dilakukan.

question.en: Write an opening for a story titled "The Locked Door".
question.bm: Tulis pembukaan untuk cerita bertajuk "The Locked Door".

steps.en: Start with action or sound to hook the reader.
steps.bm: Mulakan dengan aksi atau bunyi untuk menarik pembaca.

steps.en: Introduce the main character and the problem quickly.
steps.bm: Perkenalkan watak utama dan masalah dengan cepat.

answer.en: "Click." Hana spun around. The storeroom door had locked behind her, and the lights were flickering.
answer.bm: "Click." Hana spun around. The storeroom door had locked behind her, and the lights were flickering.
